name: Tsukushino Mitsugu
source:
In appearance, she has become somewhat chubbier than in the previous work. She is a very rich young lady, generous but sometimes stingy.

She is smart and has a wealth of knowledge about mysticism, or rather, she talks about it almost exclusively. She is psychic.
She likes Daisuke and is somewhat jealous of him.

[From [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=220493&gc=gc]getchu[/url]]
